topics.name: Routine Ordered Steps
topics.purpose: Define Routine steps as explicit ordered/dependency-bound references to commands, operations, nested routines or control constructs.

semantics.step_rule: Every step has an explicit step identity within the Routine definition.
semantics.target_rule: Executable step targets resolve exact canonical identities.
semantics.order_rule: Sequential order is explicit semantic data and never inferred only from JSON array position unless the field contract explicitly defines that array as ordered.
semantics.output_rule: Named outputs/references available to later steps are explicit.
semantics.side_effect_rule: Side effects belong to the invoked operation, not to Routine text itself.

invariants.rule: Routine definitions are explicit canonical ordered compositions of exact commands/operations/routines; runtime execution state is never embedded into the reusable definition.

hard_gates.condition: execution order inferred accidentally from serialization order
implicit dependency exists only in prose
Routine text itself executes arbitrary payload
step output consumed without explicit binding
